Interpretation: neither deletion of the faculty noun nor removal of the link retained the reasoning parent's measured result. Broaden to understanding, the third faculty in the approved minimal definition, with a matched one-word modifier contrast rather than repeating either failed deletion. This distinguishes a comprehension description from reasoning or knowledge and tests whether the own contrast transfers. These are exploratory, selected, temporally unmatched comparisons to earlier cohorts, not evidence of a general mechanism or robustness; do not pool winners. No newly measured 3/3 cohort occurred in b0018. The nine older pending audits remain unresolved. I attempted reads of all three cd6bc3ff4740d traces, but the reader truncated run-01 and run-03 after line 1146 and run-02 after line 1135, and truncated the arena-source tool outputs at line 150 to 2000 characters. Thus I do not certify a complete audit or infer absence of alternate computation, engine probes, legal enumeration, external sources or state manipulation from those partial views. The visible message indices 1/2 show definition retrieval in all three; that alone is not an unaided-play finding. No audit is certified here.
